site.name: Acerola
site.description: Documentation for Acerola — a local-first comic and manga reader that syncs your library between your own devices over P2P, with no cloud, no account, and no server to trust.
site.keywords: comic reader, manga reader, P2P sync, local-first, self-hosted, Android, desktop, Tauri, Kotlin, Rust, open source
site.og_description: Read your comics and manga on any device. Acerola syncs your library straight between your devices over P2P — no cloud, no account, no lock-in.
